_comment: Shipped blender-mcp presets. Values are applied through set_settings per scope on the running Blender; keys must exist on Blender 4.3 and 5.2 (no use_gtao, no use_hdr_view). A user preset of the same name in <settings dir>/presets shadows the shipped one.

game_bake.description: Texture baking for game engines: Cycles, 32 samples, no denoise, Standard view transform, 16-bit RGBA PNG

preview.description: Fast look-development renders: 25% resolution, 16 samples, denoise on, simplify on

final_cycles.description: Final Cycles render: 100% resolution, 256 samples, denoise on, persistent data on
